e7_s4_rationale: The mass is described as a mobile, smooth, oval, pedunculated mass, which is consistent with the typical appearance of a left ventricular myxoma. The size and location of the mass also support this diagnosis.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Papillary fibroelastoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: Papillary fibroelastomas are typically smaller and more often found on the valves

e7_s4_rejected.label: Thrombus
e7_s4_rejected.why: Thrombi are often associated with symptoms such as dyspnea and have a more irregular appearance

e7_s4_rejected.label: Fibroma
e7_s4_rejected.why: Fibromas are typically found in the ventricular septum and are less likely to be pedunculated

e7_s4_rejected.label: Rhabdomyoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: Rhabdomyomas are typically found in children and are often associated with tuberous sclerosis
